phases.name: Authentication (optional EMV 3DS for CNP)
phases.what: Merchant sends transaction, payment method and device data; frictionless or step-up (OTP, knowledge-based, biometrics). Timing not publicly specified.

phases.name: Authorisation
phases.what: Real-time request/response (ISO 8583 0100/0110 class, secondary) checking validity, status and funds; creates issuer hold and merchant record; moves no final funds. Notes summarise this clock as seconds; no timeout values publicly specified.

phases.name: Hold validity
phases.what: Uncaptured authorisations expire and release funds; vendor windows 2 to 7 days by brand and channel (Visa CNP merchant-initiated exactly 4 days 18 hours).

phases.name: Capture
phases.what: Merchant choice within hold window; partial capture releases remainder; most payments allow one capture.

phases.name: Clearing
phases.what: Merchant batches drafts at least daily; network routes to issuer; issuer match and drop; interchange assessed; usually within one day for dual-message.

phases.name: Settlement
phases.what: Net positions per client bank at cutoff; usually about two days for dual-message; single-message tied to daily cutoff; US funds move within about an hour after cutoff; Monday to Friday.

phases.name: Merchant funding
phases.what: Contractual credit by acquirer; most merchants within 24 hours of drafts entering settlement.

phases.name: Posting
phases.what: Issuer posts the transaction when the clearing presentment is matched to the authorisation and releases the hold (illustrative model from notes).

phases.name: Statementing
phases.what: Issuer statement cycle; cadence is an issuer choice not set in the sources opened. Issuer statements may not distinguish authorisations from captures (vendor).

phases.name: Reconciliation
phases.what: Notes model this as daily against network reports; cadence is an issuer and acquirer choice not set in the sources opened.

phases.name: Disputes
phases.what: Weeks to months; staged cycle per scheme rules; Mastercard first chargeback up to 120 days in most cases per secondary source (needs verification).
